details:
VRChat Version: Oculus Quest 2 Version 2021.3.4-1132–Release
Description of the bug: I have 15 Icons and taken 18 photos using the VRChat + camera. All 15 of the icon pictures are shown in game on my Oculus Quest 2 and on the VRChat website on my profile. Only 16 out of the 18 Photos I have taken in game and uploaded via the website are shown in my Gallery in the in-game menu. All 18 Photos are shown on the website. I can select Photos to be my profile picture from the website, but not in game, as the pictures are not shown. In-game, it says I have 16/64 Photos, but I have 18 Photos taken. Every time I delete one of the 16 pictures that are shown in-game, another picture that was taken after it loads in, showing me another Photo at the expense of having to delete one. I should not have to make the decision of deleting one of my 16 photos even though the maximum is 64. I am paying for the subscription, so I should be having all of my Gallery loaded in at once in-game.
Steps to reproduce (how did you encounter the bug?): I purchased the VRChat + monthly subscription and began taking photos with the new Camera and Gallery features. Over time, I took 16 pictures. All 16 were shown in the in-game Gallery. When I took my 17th picture, I went to the Gallery to see how it turned out, and it did not load into my Gallery. It said there was 16/64 Photos taken still. I looked up my profile online on the website and the website said I had 17 Photos taken, and showed me my photo, letting me also make it my profile picture without it being shown in my in-game Gallery.
Any extra files? (output logs, screenshots): No.
title: VRChat + Gallery will only show 16 Photos.
